what: A single line of text set along a wavy curve (SVG textPath) flows sideways with scroll. From when the element’s top edge is at 130% of the screen until its bottom edge reaches −100% above the screen, the start offset travels −80%. Progress chases at .05 per frame (lerp) and bends with easeOutCubic.

options.from: Initial start position (% or px), default is the textPath startOffset
options.lerp: Progress-chasing ratio (.02~.35), default .05 — larger follows immediately
options.to: End position (same unit) — if given, it flows from → to instead of delta (shica: 130% → 75%, phone 180% → 105%)
options.look: step: Clock instead of scroll — every cycle seconds it slides by (%) over move seconds with quint in-out, then rests. All the textPaths inside move together (mission text around the ellipse)
options.cycle: look: step length of one beat in seconds, default 13 (brand phone 12.5)
options.move: look: step slide duration in seconds, default 3 (brand phone 2.5)
options.by: look: step distance per move (%), default 12.5
options.wrap: look: step how many % before winding back to the start, default 50 — the path is drawn as several laps of the same curve so that % is the home position
options.scrub: If given, instead of chasing (lerp) it flows from → to with GSAP scrub (seconds) — Brand 5
options.ease: (when scrub) Curve — GSAP name or 「0.25,1,0.5,1」, default none — brand power1.out

use: <svg data-fx="path-text-drift" viewBox="0 0 1440 220"><path id="c1" d="M -572 100 C …"/><text font-size="40"><textPath href="#c1" startOffset="10%">Your one-line text here, chained two or three times · …</textPath></text></svg> — The text must be longer than the curve so it doesn’t break while flowing

from.where: index.html .sh-curve (English curve line between About and the experience)

index.js key visual, two mission lines around the ellipse — original page chunk: every 13s (12.5s on phones) for 3s (2.5s) it moves 12.5% with quint in-out, startOffset (base + r%50)%, a path four ellipse laps long
from.options: look: step; cycle: 13; move: 3; by: 12.5; wrap: 50 (phone cycle: 12.5; move: 2.5)
